Monitoring and control of hazards
Foods are complex mixtures of chemical compounds that contain not only nutrients but also many other substances among them
toxic agents and speciﬁcally animal carcinogens, which are widely distributed in the environment. Therefore, the presence of carci-
nogenic compounds in foods while not desirable is likely to happen.
